prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 78.0%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 77.4%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 73.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 93.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 70.9%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 29.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive Persona Companion Selector Flow: Adds an interactive companion personality selector screen prior to path choice, allowing users to test pet behavior responses to different traits. (why: Funnel data shows a 22% drop-off at choose_path with a mean duration of 514s, indicating hesitation when deciding on pet paths.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Companion Controls Interactive Masterclass: Introduces an interactive desktop controls walkthrough screen right after home intro, demonstrating hotkeys, hiding, and interaction modes. (why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the pet, and finish step conversion drops to 70.9%.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Sign-In Shift Following Companion Generation: Moves the sign-in step after waiting so users only create an account once their desktop pet is fully generated and ready. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing after signing in early, and sign_in experiences a 22.6% drop-off.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Habitat Construction Live Progress Stream: Displays live animated rendering updates and habitat milestone indicators while the pet renders in the background. (why: The waiting stage under home step has a high median wait time of 201s (mean 2336s), contributing to drop-offs before completion.)
4: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Rendering Accuracy Guidelines Banner: Adds an inline clarity guide on photo upload screen showing acceptable lighting and face framing for custom pet creation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected facial rendering results.)
5: [finish, hint] Desktop Tray Accessibility & Control Dock Prompt: Adds an explicit shortcut hint and system tray badge to the home welcome screen explaining how to interact with the pet. (why: Multiple users contacted support confused about how to hide, show, or open settings for their desktop pet after setup.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Path Companion Archetype Comparison Banner: Updates choose_path copy with detailed descriptions highlighting exact differences between pre-made and custom photo paths. (why: 22% of users drop off at choose_path and take an average of 514s, indicating confusion about which path to choose.)
